lines.text: Pharaoh dreams beside the Nile that seven thin cows devour seven sleek, well-fed cows.
Pharaoh dreams of seven plump heads of grain swallowed by thin ones, and the magicians of Egypt cannot interpret it.
The chief cupbearer tells Pharaoh that a young Hebrew interpreted their dreams, and the chief baker was crucified.
Joseph tells Pharaoh the dreams mean seven years of abundance followed by seven years of plague.
Joseph advises Pharaoh to appoint commissioners to take a fifth of the harvest and store grain in the cities.
